description: Use this to see whether this account encrypts new message bodies and whether the owner has locked the agent out. Read-only; requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (omit when this key is limited to one inbox; it only checks that the inbox is yours). Returns {object:"inbox_encryption", enabled, key_configured, locked, locked_at}. enabled true means new bodies and attachment bytes are sealed with a per-account key. Existing plaintext still reads. locked true means read and send return HTTP 403 account_locked until the owner unlocks. The owner turns the lock with POST /api/v1/owner/agents/{inbox}/lock. Enabling encryption is POST /api/v1/inboxes/{id}/encryption {"enabled":true}. Without COOPER_INBOX_ENCRYPTION_KEY that call is HTTP 503 encryption_unavailable. The default flag is on. This result has no message body.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id, username, or email. Omit it when this key is limited to one inbox.

name: cooper_get_mailbox_encryption

outputSchema.description: Whether new mail is encrypted and whether the owner locked the agent.

enabled.description: True after this account turned encryption on.

key_configured.description: True when the operator key is set. No key material is returned.

locked.description: True when the owner has locked the agent out of read and send.

locked_at.description: ISO-8601 time of the lock, or null.

title: Get mailbox encryption
